newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian sugar prices steady, strike hurts arrivals.
newsitem.headline: Indian sugar prices steady, strike hurts arrivals.

text.p: Indian sugar prices on Wednesday were steady at improved levels, dealers said.
Consumer demand remained slow at higher levels as well offerings owing to the absence of fresh arrivals from mills to the market.
"Prices in the ready delivery are indicated nominally without any major deals," one broker said.
Sugar S-30 in the ready delivery was quoted at 1,350/1,425 rupees per quintal while M-30 was quoted at 1,425/1,450 rupees per quintal.
"Sugar arrivals from mills to the local market remained virtually absent on account of the nationwide strike by transport operators protesting, since April 1," he said.

"The absence of lifting from mills due to the truckers strike has created plenty of problems with mill owners. Production of sugar at mills continues and as there is no lifting, and we are facing a problem of glut," one miller said. -- Bombay Commodities +91-22-265 9000
